{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Filter to completed orders
completed_only = sales[sales['status'] == 'completed']

# Parse revenue and remove QA orders
completed_only['revenue_numeric'] = completed_only['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)
valid_orders = completed_only[completed_only['revenue_numeric'] != 999999.99]

# Now, compute the raw difference in conversion rates
# Only use valid_orders for the population
email_converted = valid_orders[valid_orders['channel'] == 'email']['converted'].sum()
email_count = len(valid_orders[valid_orders['channel'] == 'email'])
email_rate = email_converted / email_count

paid_search_converted = valid_orders[valid_orders['channel'] == 'paid_search']['converted'].sum()
paid_search_count = len(valid_orders[valid_orders['channel'] == 'paid_search'])
paid_search_rate = paid_search_converted / paid_search_count

difference = email_rate - paid_search_rate

# Print all values as computed
print('Number of completed orders:', len(completed_only))
print('Number of valid orders after QA removal:', len(valid_orders))
print('Email conversion rate:', email_rate)
print('Paid search conversion rate:', paid_search_rate)
print('Difference (email - paid_search):', difference)

# Cross-tabulation
cross_tab = pd.crosstab(valid_orders['channel'], valid_orders['customer_segment'])
print('Cross-tabulation of channel vs customer_segment:\n', cross_tab)

# Segment-wise conversion rates
conversion_by_segment = valid_orders.groupby(['channel', 'customer_segment'])['converted'].mean().unstack(level='customer_segment')
print('Conversion rates by channel and segment:\n', conversion_by_segment)

# Segment-wise differences
segment_diffs = conversion_by_segment.loc['email'] - conversion_by_segment.loc['paid_search']
print('Difference (email - paid_search) by segment:\n', segment_diffs)"}
